# NPR
> NPR is a nonprofit news organization covering breaking news, politics, world affairs, science, health, arts, music, and podcasts.

NPR publishes reporting, analysis, interviews, reviews, and audio programming across major news and culture topics, with section pages, topic hubs, podcasts, newsletters, and live radio access.

## Main News
- [Home](https://www.npr.org/): NPR homepage with top stories, featured reporting, and major audio segments.
- [News](https://www.npr.org/sections/news/): Central news hub for breaking coverage and top stories across beats.
- [National](https://www.npr.org/sections/national/): U.S. national news, public policy, courts, and domestic affairs coverage.
- [World](https://www.npr.org/sections/world/): International reporting on global politics, conflict, and major world events.
- [Politics](https://www.npr.org/sections/politics/): Coverage of elections, Congress, the White House, and political analysis.
- [Business](https://www.npr.org/sections/business/): Reporting on markets, labor, the economy, companies, and consumer issues.

## Science, Health & Environment
- [Health](https://www.npr.org/sections/health/): Health reporting on medicine, public health, policy, and wellness.
- [Science](https://www.npr.org/sections/science/): Science news covering research, space, technology, and discoveries.
- [Climate](https://www.npr.org/sections/climate/): Climate change reporting on energy, environment, and adaptation.
- [Shots](https://www.npr.org/sections/health-shots/): NPR's health blog with explainers, reporting, and medical news.
- [Goats and Soda](https://www.npr.org/sections/goats-and-soda/): Global health and development reporting with international human-centered stories.
- [The Salt](https://www.npr.org/sections/thesalt/): Food, nutrition, agriculture, and food systems reporting.

## Culture, Arts & Entertainment
- [Culture](https://www.npr.org/sections/culture/): Broad arts and culture coverage spanning entertainment and criticism.
- [Books](https://www.npr.org/books/): Book news, reviews, author interviews, and reading recommendations.
- [Movies](https://www.npr.org/sections/movies/): Film reviews, industry coverage, and interviews with filmmakers.
- [Television](https://www.npr.org/sections/television/): TV criticism, show coverage, and interviews with creators and actors.
- [Pop Culture](https://www.npr.org/sections/pop-culture/): Commentary and reporting on trends, fandom, and entertainment.
- [Art & Design](https://www.npr.org/sections/art-design/): Visual art, architecture, photography, and design coverage.
- [Food](https://www.npr.org/sections/food/): Food culture, cooking, restaurants, and culinary reporting.
- [Performing Arts](https://www.npr.org/sections/performing-arts/): Coverage of theater, dance, opera, and live performance.

## Race, Identity & Society
- [Code Switch](https://www.npr.org/sections/codeswitch/): Reporting and commentary on race, identity, and social issues.
- [Education](https://www.npr.org/sections/education/): News on schools, higher education, policy, and learning.
- [Religion](https://www.npr.org/sections/religion/): Reporting on faith, belief, and religion in public life.
- [Law](https://www.npr.org/sections/law/): Legal news covering courts, justice, and major rulings.
- [Immigration](https://www.npr.org/tags/126030994/immigration): Topic page aggregating NPR immigration reporting and analysis.

## Music
- [Music](https://www.npr.org/music/): NPR Music hub for coverage, criticism, performances, and features.
- [Tiny Desk](https://www.npr.org/series/tiny-desk-concerts/): Tiny Desk concerts featuring live performances and artist sessions.
- [New Music Friday](https://www.npr.org/sections/allsongs/606254804/new-music-friday): Weekly recommendations and discussion of notable new releases.
- [All Songs Considered](https://www.npr.org/podcasts/510019/all-songs-considered): Music discovery podcast with artist features and listening picks.
- [Jazz Night in America](https://www.npr.org/podcasts/381444908/jazz-night-in-america): Podcast and radio program focused on jazz performance and culture.
- [Alt.Latino](https://www.npr.org/podcasts/510315/alt-latino): Coverage of Latin music, artists, and listening recommendations.
- [Classical](https://www.npr.org/music/genres/classical/): Classical music news, reviews, and performance features.

## Podcasts & Audio
- [Podcasts](https://www.npr.org/podcasts/): Directory of NPR podcasts across news, culture, and storytelling.
- [Up First](https://www.npr.org/podcasts/510318/up-first): Daily morning news podcast covering the biggest stories in brief.
- [Consider This](https://www.npr.org/podcasts/510355/considerthis): Short-form daily news analysis focused on one major story.
- [Fresh Air](https://www.npr.org/podcasts/381444908/fresh-air): Interviews and cultural conversations hosted by Terry Gross and Tonya Mosley.
- [Planet Money](https://www.npr.org/podcasts/510289/planet-money): Economics podcast explaining money, markets, and policy through stories.
- [Code Switch Podcast](https://www.npr.org/podcasts/510312/codeswitch): Podcast about race, identity, and how they shape society.
- [Wait Wait... Don't Tell Me!](https://www.npr.org/podcasts/344098539/wait-wait-dont-tell-me): Weekly news quiz blending current events and comedy.
- [Life Kit](https://www.npr.org/podcasts/510338/all-guides): Practical advice and how-to guidance across everyday topics.

## Shows & Programs
- [Morning Edition](https://www.npr.org/programs/morning-edition/): NPR's weekday morning news magazine with reporting and interviews.
- [All Things Considered](https://www.npr.org/programs/all-things-considered/): Evening news program with top stories, features, and analysis.
- [Weekend Edition Saturday](https://www.npr.org/programs/weekend-edition-saturday/): Saturday news magazine with interviews and feature reporting.
- [Weekend Edition Sunday](https://www.npr.org/programs/weekend-edition-sunday/): Sunday news program covering politics, culture, and current events.
- [Here & Now](https://www.npr.org/programs/here-and-now/): Daily news magazine produced with WBUR.
- [1A](https://www.npr.org/podcasts/510316/1a): National conversation program on politics, culture, and public life.
- [Throughline](https://www.npr.org/podcasts/510333/throughline): History podcast connecting past events to current issues.

## Newsletters & Accounts
- [Newsletters](https://www.npr.org/newsletters/): Newsletter signup hub for NPR news, culture, and podcast updates.
- [NPR One](https://www.npr.org/about-npr/473636949/npr-one): Information about NPR's personalized listening app and service.
- [Listen Live](https://www.npr.org/listen/): Live audio stream and station listening options.
- [Stations](https://www.npr.org/stations/): Directory of NPR member stations across the United States.
- [NPR Shop](https://shopnpr.org/): Official store for NPR merchandise and gifts.

## About NPR
- [About NPR](https://www.npr.org/about/): Overview of NPR's mission, organization, and public service journalism.
- [Ethics Handbook](https://www.npr.org/about-npr/688405012/the-npr-ethics-handbook): Editorial ethics and standards guiding NPR journalism.
- [Corrections](https://www.npr.org/sections/corrections/): Published corrections and clarifications to NPR reporting.
- [Contact NPR](https://www.npr.org/contact/): Contact information for NPR departments and audience inquiries.
- [Careers](https://www.npr.org/careers/): Employment opportunities and workplace information at NPR.
- [Support Public Radio](https://www.npr.org/donations/support): Donation and membership support information for NPR.
